quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Wemby's unbelievable all-around offensive game and athleticism
quotes.quote: The tone was set by Wemby, and it's just crazy. I was watching him last night and there's not one thing he cannot do on the basketball court. Even just watch those highlights: his handle, his shot taking, his shot making. It truly is unbelievable just with his size and his athleticism and his handle and his just offensive game. It doesn't make sense. It's ridiculous.
